1) (Currently amended) A composition for topical use comprising a) __the active ingredient comprising a compound of formula I__ or 2, b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles, and c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care and/or inflammation-inhibiting action.

2) (Currently amended) A composition according to one or more of the claims 1 or 3, wherein the active ingredient is contained in said composition in an amount of 0.00001 per cent by weight to 10 per cent by weight. 

3) (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the manufacture of a cosmetic composition for the treatment of skin diseases __including but not limited to__ those associated with defective keratinisation.

4) (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the preparation of a composition which is suitable for the prophylaxis and/or treatment of skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation __such as acne vulgaris, acne comedonica, polymorphic acne, acne rosaceae, and other defects of keratinisation__.

5) (Currently amended) Use the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the care, preservation or improvement of the general state of the skin or hair __including the reduction of skin unevenness, such as wrinkles, fine lines, rough skin or large-pored skin__.

6) (Currently amended) Use of the composition according to Claim 1 or 2 for skin lightening and/or skin whitening __wherein said composition is used for improving skin appearance__.

7) (Currently amended) Use the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the prophylaxis against time- and/or light-induced ageing processes of the human skin __with an emphasis on preventing dry skin and wrinkle formation__.
